LayerType.condition: Known shipped visual and nonvisual types have native handlers; an unknown type remains a named diagnostic, never dropped.

ExtensionDefinition.condition: Native fragment/mesh definitions must be installed; v1-3 raster overrides need the V8 recorder producer, not a browser.

Effects.condition: Requires the definition set or EffectHost; absent renderer configuration is a named error.

Masks.condition: No production constructor remains; keep the variant while public consumers still use it (prune rule).

Transition.condition: Native definition programs or a caller EffectHost draw transitions; native resource limits are tracked by ShaderFallback.

MotionBlur.condition: Every shipped visual type is in the sampled-type list; unknown layer types remain explicit.

TwoAndAHalfD.condition: Every shipped plane type is supported; unknown future types remain explicit.

Adjustment.condition: Native effect chain on the accumulator; definitions must be installed.

CompatLevel2.condition: No production constructor remains; native sampling/coverage applies to every level.

RequiresEngine.condition: All current stamping fields are drawn or judged by their own capability check; not a legacy fallback trigger.

ProjectColor.condition: Standard, linear blending and project precision are native. Unknown/future wide-gamut, HDR and ACES project modes need the professional-color contract; do not silently reinterpret them.

ImageSequence.condition: Persisted v1-3 WebM renditions use native video. Direct GIF/APNG/WebP/AVIF animation and original-sequence runtime providers remain required; metadata/readers and proxy manifest support alone do not complete playback.

Media.condition: See e2e-ledger.md media subreason table: native readers and GPU conversion depend on Apple media/frameworks. Genuine absent codecs/readings remain blocked, never called a hardware verification pass.

Request.condition: Precision/target limits require the Metal adapter; configured-font requests need CoreText. Invalid requests remain named errors.

Definition.condition: Missing definitions are input/host lifecycle failures, not a renderer fallback. Native child exports must serialize the definitions and project fonts (native-service owner).

ShaderFallback.condition: Native sampler/resource coverage is incomplete (S4 has 13 WebGL-only cases). No Node/Chromium runner can satisfy N8. Mac lane must implement/test those resource bindings and native compile failures, not enable the old runner.

Text.condition: Install CoreText/project fonts; exercise glyph paint errors at execution as well as the static fonts flag. Missing font configuration is not a legacy fallback.

L7.requirement: Mac audio decode/mix/stretch/playback suites, strict AUDIO-2 start bound, allocation and listening gates; eliminate Chromium decoder dependency and legacy-export retiming before N8/N3 closure.

AUDIO-DEV-1.requirement: Portable device policy has Linux proof; wire SystemDeviceProbe/DeviceMonitor to actual stream reopening and run physical route/rate/channel/hotplug/large-buffer gates.

Log interpretation.requirement: H.273 9/10 is implemented/tested on CPU and source WGSL validates. Mac image/video probe-to-pixel proof remains. Proprietary camera logs/gamuts require explicit source-reading definitions; no guess from filenames.

Standards gaps.requirement: CHROMA-420-1 decimation quality remains open; HEIF HDR transfer and unsupported color descriptions require exact readings. EXR/DPX source tests added but not run on Metal.

WebM settings.requirement: Native libvpx realtime settings remain; Mac matched-quality throughput, alpha, Opus priming/duration and tag validation must pass.

SHADER-RES-1.requirement: Preserve logical resolution/u_res/uniform calls; constant-table hoisting compiles. Native sampler types/arrays and Metal compile inventory remain; S4 is not green.

Phase 4a proxies.requirement: Policy/store/cache integrated; native engine-service generation, representation, paused upgrade and preview-cache bindings are unowned here and still required.

Bigrender.requirement: Prepared-track cache and native prewarming integrated; run exact frames/allocations/peak texture memory and real playback/scrub/export on the required Macs.

Corpus and performance.requirement: External frozen captures and Apple hardware unavailable; G-C/G-T/G-I/G-E/G-X, cadence/AV sync, full corpus and preview=export need requalification. Pending fingerprints remain unmodified.

Desktop protocol consumer.requirement: pm-protocol::wire::typescript_regeneration_is_a_no_op fails because the generated desktop index build id is stale. The exact owned-documentation patch is ready; only its desktop owner may apply/regenerate that out-of-lane path. Do not relax the handshake or drift test.
